Why are students applying to thousands of roles but only receiving automated rejections?
We analyze the data and break down the three hidden forces shrinking the entry-level job funnel: 1. Silent Hiring Freezes (Ghost Jobs): Why companies post openings without the intention of hiring. 2. Corporate Sponsorship Fears: How new extreme H-1B petition fees are making employers hesitant to sponsor international students. 3. The AI Impact: How AI coding assistants are consuming the routine, entry-level tasks that used to be the training ground for junior developers.
Beyond the harsh realities of the 90-day OPT clock and compounding loan interest, we provide a practical, data-backed playbook for students.
From building a professor network on Day 1 to understanding why India's GCC boom (Hyderabad & Bengaluru) or diversifying destinations like Europe and the UK might be your smartest Plan B.

item.title: Simple Janmashtami Puja at Home | Complete Step-by-Step Guide for Beginners
item.description:
Want to perform a simple Janmashtami puja at home but not sure where to begin?
In this video, I guide you through a simple Krishna Janmashtami puja step by step, designed especially for beginners and families who want to celebrate at home without making the ritual unnecessarily complicated.
You do not need to buy a Laddu Gopal, perform Panchamrita abhishekam, keep an elaborate jhula or know difficult Sanskrit mantras. Even a simple Krishna photo is enough for this puja.
We begin with the morning setup and go through each step slowly — preparing the puja space, lighting the deepam, taking a simple sankalpam, offering gandha, flowers and Tulsi, chanting Krishna’s name, offering naivedyam and drinking water, performing aarti and finally completing the puja with namaskara.
I also explain the meaning behind each important step, so you are not simply copying a ritual without understanding why it is being performed.
For naivedyam, you do not need to prepare many dishes. Even one fruit or a homemade sweet is enough. You may also offer butter and mishri or avalakki — beaten rice — which has a beautiful association with Krishna through the story of Sudama.
In the video, I also answer some of the most common Janmashtami questions:
• Do I need Laddu Gopal for Janmashtami puja? • Is abhishekam compulsory? • What if I do not have Tulsi or flowers? • What can I offer as naivedyam? • How should I observe fasting? • What can children do during Janmashtami? • What should we do for Krishna Janma at midnight? • What should we do with the prasadam, flowers and Tulsi after the puja? • When should we clear the Janmashtami setup?
If your family celebrates Krishna Janma at midnight, you can gather again for bhajans, nama japa and aarti. Midnight, during Nishita Kaal, is traditionally the central moment of the Janmashtami celebration.
The following morning, you can thank Krishna and respectfully clear the temporary Janmashtami decorations.
Most importantly, remember Krishna’s teaching:
Patram Pushpam Phalam Toyam — a leaf, a flower, a fruit or even water offered with devotion is accepted by him.
So do not worry if your puja is simple. Offer what you have, chant Krishna’s name and celebrate Janmashtami with devotion.
Save this video so you can follow it during your puja, and please share it with someone who may be celebrating Janmashtami at home without anyone beside them to guide them.
Om Namo Bhagavate Vasudevaya.

item.title: Paper Girls
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: Paper Girls.

Paper Girls follows four young girls who, while out delivering papers on the morning after Halloween in 1988, become unwittingly caught in a conflict between warring factions of time-travelers, sending them on an adventure through time that will save the world. As they travel between our present, the past, and the future — they encounter future versions of themselves and now must choose to embrace or reject their fate. An emotional adventure in which the girls and the women they eventually become are tough, their friendships are authentic, and their journey through time is epic.

item.title: Drops of God
item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: Drops of God.

Drops of God is set in the world of gastronomy and fine wines, which are in mourning as Alexandre Léger, creator of the famous Léger Wine Guide and emblematic figure in oenology, has just passed away at his home in Tokyo at the age of 60. He left behind a daughter, Camille, who lives in Paris and hasn't seen her father since her parents separated when she was nine years old. When Camille flies to Tokyo and Léger's will is read, she discovers that her father has left her an extraordinary wine collection – the greatest collection in the world according to the experts. But, to claim the inheritance, Camille must compete with a brilliant young oenologist, Issei Tomine, who her father took under his wing and is referred to in Léger's will as his "spiritual son." But is his connection to Issei only spiritual?

item.description:
A new show has been added to showRSS: Star City.

Star City is a propulsive, paranoid thriller that takes us back to the key moment in the alt-history retelling of the space race — when the Soviet Union became the first nation to put a man on the moon.
